description: The pie chart is designed to compare two categories: "Efficient deployment" and "Reduction." There are two slices in the chart. The "Efficient deployment" slice is colored blue and represents 26.2% of the chart, while the "Reduction" slice is colored orange and accounts for 69.92% of the chart. The chart includes percentage labels inside the slices, with the "Reduction" slice being the larger and more dominant portion. The slices are not visually emphasized in any particular way, such as being exploded, offset, or bolded. The chart does not include a legend, as the categories are directly labeled on the slices themselves.
